Ahmed Ziad Chabane — Early-career DevOps Engineer

Location: Algeria (UTC+1) Remote: Yes — preferably international remote roles with European/EMEA timezone overlap. Willing to relocate: Yes, with visa sponsorship.

Technologies: Linux, Python, Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Minikube, Helm, Argo CD, Terraform, AWS (LocalStack/Moto), Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, PostgreSQL, Redis, Trivy, Checkov.

GitHub: https://github.com/ziadchabane LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ahmed-ziad-chabane-44b095398/ Résumé/CV: https://github.com/ziadchabane Email: youngerthanbigbrother24@gmail.com

I'm an early-career DevOps engineer focused on automation, containerization, infrastructure as code, and observability.

My main project is an ongoing 180-day engineering journey built around a Flask application. I've worked on Docker containerization, Kubernetes deployments with Helm, CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, GitOps with Argo CD, and monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, Loki and Promtail.

I also document engineering challenges and troubleshooting, including Kubernetes networking, Nginx 502 errors, monitoring configuration, and CI/CD configuration drift.

Alongside this, I've been developing Terraform-based AWS infrastructure labs validated locally with LocalStack and a Python CLI for AWS resource automation using Moto.

I'm looking for junior DevOps, Cloud or Platform Engineering opportunities where I can contribute to automation, deployment workflows, infrastructure and reliability while continuing to grow as an engineer.

Open to full-time opportunities and well-scoped paid projects.
